results.title: Gingerbread House Contest Kit Printable, Gingerbread Decorating Party Kit, Voting Ballots, Scorecards, Award Certificates PDF
results.description:
Some parties serve dessert. This one builds it, judges it, and hands it a certificate.

The Gingerbread House Decorating Contest Party Kit is the whole contest in one printable: the host plan and shopping list, the rules nobody can argue with, houses judged by number (never by name — that is what keeps it fair and keeps it fun), ballots for the whole room, scorecards and a real judging rubric for the serious table, and six awards with certificates and ribbons — including Most Likely to Be Condemned, the honor every table secretly wants to win and nobody wants to hang in the kitchen.

Run it three ways with the same kit: people's-choice ballots only, a full judged contest with scorecards, or both. Six categories mean six chances — a wobbly classic can miss Best Overall and still take Most Traditional, and the leaning tower of candy canes can win the room's heart.

WHAT'S INSIDE — 12 CONTEST TOOLS, 24 PAGES
★ Host Guide — a week-out timeline, a two-hour party-day run of show, and the full shopping checklist
★ Contest Rules — a display page for the head of the table, plus 8 cut-out rules cards
★ Entry Numbers & Table Tents — Houses #1–8, folded and stood in front of each build
★ Entry Registration Cards — 8 cards: builders, house name (kept secret until the ceremony), and its story
★ Voting Ballots — 8 ballots covering all six categories
★ Judge Scorecards — 4 scorecards scoring craft, creativity, candy work, and charm out of 10 each
★ Judging Rubric & Host Tally Sheet — what the points mean, plus the grid that crowns the winners
★ Award Certificates — all six titles: Most Traditional, Most Creative, Most Likely to Be Condemned, Best Use of Candy, Tallest & Still Standing, Best Overall
★ Award Ribbons — 8 cut-and-pin ribbons, including Champion Builder and Sweetest Sport
★ Building Tips & Royal Icing Recipe Cards — eight earned-the-hard-way tips and the stiff-peak icing that holds it all up (two identical cards)
★ Candy Planning Worksheet — what each house actually needs, job by job, before you hit the aisle
★ Photo Scavenger Hunt, Kids' Coloring Page & the Structural Disaster Repair Kit — twelve shots to capture, a house to color, and official, calm guidance for leaning walls and roof slides

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the PDF instantly after checkout — nothing ships.
2. Print at home on US Letter paper (8.5" × 11") at 100% scale. Color looks best; black & white reads perfectly.
3. Cut the tents, cards, ballots, ribbons, and certificates along the light lines — light cardstock makes them sturdier.
4. Set out the numbers, read the rules aloud once, start the clock, and let the judging begin.

Print as many copies as your party needs — one ballot per guest, one scorecard per judge per house — and reprint next December. Defending champions expect it.

PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download; no physical item will be shipped.
• Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.
• All candy in this kit is described generically (gumdrops, candy canes, peppermint discs) — stock your table with whatever your bakers love.
• For personal use. Please don't share, resell, or redistribute the file — send friends to the shop instead so they can grab their own copy.

Designed with care and a little help from AI tools; every page, rule, and rubric was written, checked, and laid out by the shop owner.
